mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aup_data (aup_id, data, version, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{aupId}, #{data}, #{version}, #{updatedBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE aup_data SET data = #{data}, version = version + 1, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE aup_id = #{aupId} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
